invariants.rule: certification margin is applied exactly once
all radius and margin quantities use meters
point-to-ellipsoid formula is unchanged from V1
PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN sign semantics are unchanged from V1
state/map frame convention is unchanged from V1

query state remains robot position state[0:3]

controller runtime and selected action remain unchanged
